get_hfconfig: get the HuggingFace model config for a given model ID and config section name
model_from_hfconfig: build an OfflineAsr instance by downloading model files from a HuggingFace repo using its config
transcribe_batch_from_tensor: transcribe a single audio tensor batch using an existing OfflineAsr model
OfflineAsr_init: create an OfflineAsr instance with a neural model file, BPE or token file, and decoding method
OfflineAsr_decode_waves: decode a list of audio wave tensors into transcribed text strings using an OfflineAsr model
